user.title: Connect to the ABUS Secvest panel
user.description:
Tested with the {model} running firmware {firmware}; other panels and firmware versions are untested.

Use a separate panel user for Home Assistant: the level "normal user" is enough, with rights for exactly the partitions Home Assistant should operate. The installer code doesn't work, the panel's API accepts users only.

data_description.url: The panel's address, e.g. 192.168.1.10 (port 4433) or 192.168.1.10:4433, or the https URL of a reverse proxy in front of it.
data_description.user_code: The code of the panel user Home Assistant logs in with.
data_description.password: The password of that panel user.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the panel's own self-signed certificate; turn on behind a reverse proxy with a valid certificate.

data_description.user_agent: Sent with every request. Leave empty for the default, ha-secvest/ followed by the version; only needed for a reverse proxy that filters by User-Agent.

partitions.title: Select partitions
partitions.description:
Select the partitions Home Assistant should show and operate. Their zones are added automatically.

The panel doesn't reveal which partitions the user may operate, so all of them are listed; partitions without zones are deselected. Commands for a partition the user has no rights for are refused by the panel.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The panel rejected the user code or password for {name}. Nothing is sent to the panel with the old credentials anymore. Enter the credentials of the panel user again; they are checked with a single request.

data_description.user_code: The code of the panel user Home Assistant logs in with.
data_description.password: The password of that panel user.

error.invalid_address: Enter a host name or IP address, optionally with a port, or an https URL.
error.invalid_auth: The panel rejected the user code or password. Nothing is retried automatically; check the credentials and try again.
error.installer_locked: The installer is logged in at the panel, which locks the API. Try again after the installer has logged out.
error.cannot_connect: The panel could not be reached. Check the address and the network.
error.timeout: The panel did not answer in time. Check the address; the panel may be busy.
error.unexpected_response: The address answered, but not like a Secvest panel. Check the address (and the path behind a reverse proxy).

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.

auth_failed.message: The panel rejected the user code or password. Nothing is sent with them anymore; reauthenticate to continue.
